# Daily Planner

> Owner: Eliziejus  ·  Created: 2026-08-20

## Begin (raw)
<!-- 3-minute brain dump. Do not edit or reinterpret. -->

I want to create a website with calendar and daily tasks. Can you do it for me?

## Refine (scope)
- **Goal**: A website with a week-strip calendar; clicking a day shows that day's task list. Tasks have a title, time, and notes.
- **In / Out of scope**: In — week navigation (prev/next), per-day task list, add/edit/complete/delete task, localStorage persistence. Out — month view, recurring tasks, incomplete-task rollover, accounts/backend/sync.
- **Definition of Done**: User can navigate weeks, pick a day, and add/edit/complete/delete tasks (title + time + notes) for that day, with data surviving a page reload via localStorage.
- **Constraints**: No backend — localStorage only. Static site, no build step (per root CONTEXT.md).
- **Risks**: (none major — small MVP scope)
- **Resources**: (none)
- **Dependencies**: (none)
